D5/S3/Fourier/CharacterSelection/Simplex.name: D5.S3.Fourier.CharacterSelection.SimplexTwoCochainRepair.tetra_defects_incidence_repair_and_exactness
D5/S3/Fourier/CharacterSelection/Simplex.signature: theorem tetra_defects_incidence_repair_and_exactness {V : Type u} {A : Type v} [Fintype V] [Nonempty V] [AddCommGroup A] (F : V → V → V → A) : (∑ r : V, faceErrors F r) = tetraDefects F ∧ (∃ r : V, Fintype.card V * faceErrors F r ≤ tetraDefects F) ∧ (∀ edge : V → V → A, tetraDefects F ≤ 4 * Fintype.card V * edgeErrors F edge) ∧ ((∀ r i j k, F i j k - F r j k + F r i k - F r i j = 0) ↔ ∃ edge : V → V → A, ∀ i j k, F i j k = edge j k - edge i k + edge i j)
